## What and why

<!-- What changes, and what problem it solves. One paragraph. -->

## Type

- [ ] `feat` new capability
- [ ] `fix` bug fix
- [ ] `docs` documentation only
- [ ] `refactor` behaviour unchanged
- [ ] `test` tests only
- [ ] `chore` dependencies, tooling
- [ ] `security` fixes a vulnerability

## Teaching impact

<!-- This is a teaching repository, so a change can be technically correct and
     pedagogically wrong. -->

- [ ] Does not remove a deliberate defect (see the table in README)
- [ ] If it changes a deliberate defect, the private solutions repo is updated
- [ ] If it changes a day's exercise, that `docs/DAYn.md` is updated

## Checks

- [ ] `make check` passes locally
- [ ] Pre-commit hook installed and passing
- [ ] No real credentials. Placeholders are registered in `DUMMY-VALUES.md`
- [ ] `VERIFICATION.md` updated if execution status changed
